text:
jess: Heads-up — want to lock down the partner incentives budget flow and scorecard metrics before the QBR next week. We're getting mixed asks from SI and cloud partners about approval lead time.

sam: +1. We need a single source of truth for who approves MDF requests and what scorecard signals unlock higher tiers.

tyler: Quick thought — split gating into 2 axes: eligibility (scorecard + enablement) and budget path (auto vs manual).

maria: Agree. For eligibility we should require: 1) 2 joint enablement sessions in last 90d, 2) pipeline influence >= $25k MRR, 3) signed co-marketing plan.

anil: Can we make the scorecard signals numeric? Sales-influenced ACV, joint demos/month, deal contribution %, and partner NPS. That helps automation.

sam: If we quantize: ACV influence (0-10), enablement (0-5), co-sell activity (0-10), NPS (0-5) -> threshold 18/30 to auto-approve up to $10k.

jess: That matches what I was imagining. For >$10k requests, require Finance review; >$50k needs VP signoff. We should document an approval SLA (72h for auto, 5 business days for manual).

maria: I'll draft a short approval matrix. Something like:
```
approval_matrix:
  < $10k  -> auto if score >= 18 (auto SLA 72h)
  $10k-$50k -> Partnerships PM + Finance review (SLA 5bd)
  > $50k -> VP signoff + finance committee (SLA 10bd)
```

tyler: Nice. Also propose an "appeals" flow if partner disputes score: 1x manual re-review by Partnerships lead within 3bd.

san: (typo) — meant anil.

anil: We should include a decaying weight for old activities — enablement older than 180d drops to 50% weight. Keeps recent engagement prioritized.

sam: Ops question: who will own the automated checks (enablement session logs, pipeline influence)? My vote: Partnerships PMs build the rules, Eng-Devex owns the webhook + enforcement.

jess: Sounds good. @tyler can you capture the required data fields for the webhook? I'll sync with Eng-Devex.

tyler: Will do. Minimal fields: partner_id, request_id, score_components (ACV_influenced, demos, enablement_count, NPS), request_amount, requested_use. Example payload in a follow-up.

maria: Finance asks for monthly rollups so they can forecast. We should add a monthly MDF burn report export to the Console (csv and sql).

finance-bot: Note: budget cadence reminder — FYQ2 partner incentive pool freeze on 1760000000. Submit requests early. :calendar:

jess: Action items:
- maria: draft approval matrix and examples (today)
- tyler: post sample webhook payload (tomorrow)
- sam: write automation acceptance criteria and handoff doc (EOD Friday)
- anil: propose decay function and scoring weight doc (Monday)
- jess: schedule 30m sync with Eng-Devex + Finance (tomorrow)

maria: I'll post the matrix to this thread once done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

tyler: I'll drop the payload in #eng-oncall and ping @eng-devex.

sam: Will start the acceptance checklist.

jess: Great — let's aim to have the public-facing partner FAQ + matrix ready before the QBR so AMs have clear answers.
